plan.goal: Find and rank representative UniProt sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins bearing ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (GO:0097322) and NADPHX epimerase (GO:0097320) activity, grounded by literature context and scored by sequence composition and lightweight QC scalars.
assumptions: GO:0097322 is the canonical molecular-function term for ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity and is used as the primary functional GO filter for the dehydratase arm.
GO:0097320 is the canonical molecular-function term for NAD(P)HX epimerase activity and is used as the primary functional GO filter for the epimerase arm.
IPR023195 covers the NAD(P)HX repair enzyme superfamily and captures both bifunctional prokaryotic and specialised eukaryotic members across taxa.
Only reviewed (Swiss-Prot) sequences are retrieved to maximise annotation quality; unreviewed TrEMBL entries are excluded.
Length filter 100–600 aa removes likely fragments and large multidomain fusion constructs while retaining all known monofunctional and bifunctional repair domains.
IEA-only GO annotations are excluded (exclude_iea=true) to avoid low-confidence computational assignments inflating the candidate set.
Literature search is grounding-only; GO and InterPro accessions are hardcoded from established UniProt/EBI records and are expected to be confirmed by search results.
protein_qc is applied per-sequence via foreach fan-out over each retrieval node's sequence list; all five metric scalars (plddt, polybasic, gravy, instability_index, pi) are collected.
rank_designs aggregates all sequence_analysis annotation records and protein_qc scalar sets to emit a deterministic top-20 ranked representative list.
No structure prediction, docking, or backbone generation is required for this sequence-understanding task.
Final Reason: and Answer: fields will be populated from rank_designs top-K output after workflow execution.

success_criteria.sequences_retrieved: >=10 reviewed UniProt sequences collectively across GO:0097322, GO:0097320, and IPR023195 queries
success_criteria.analyses_complete: sequence_analysis annotation records and all five protein_qc scalars (pI, instability_index, GRAVY, polybasic, pLDDT-proxy) produced for every retrieved sequence
success_criteria.ranking_output: rank_designs emits a deterministic top-20 representative list with per-candidate pI, instability_index, GRAVY, charge, and motif/region annotation summary
success_criteria.literature_grounding: >=5 Europe PMC records contextualising NAD(P)HX repair biology, GO accession assignments, and phylogenetic distribution of repair enzymes

inputs.query: NAD(P)HX repair protein NADHX dehydratase epimerase ADP-dependent metabolite damage
